version.value: Tenor with acoustic orchestral accompaniment; Italian
version.note: This is the original acoustic recording, not the later electrically re-orchestrated dubs which DAHR lists separately as CS-58966. Performing edition unknown.

performers.note: Orchestral accompaniment is documented, but no orchestra name, conductor or individual orchestral players are established by the cited sources.

date.note: Date of the original acoustic session, not of a later reissue or dub.

label.note: The transferred label is identified in the IA metadata; the underlying master is Victor.

catalogue.note: The physical pressing date is unknown; 1907 identifies the original recording and issue history, not this copy’s manufacture.

matrixTakeSides.note: DAHR identifies take 1 as the issued master for Victor 88061; take 2 was held. This identifies the master through the catalogue, not through inspection of a legible runout. IA’s matrix field repeats the catalogue number 88061 and is not accepted as the matrix.

credits.note: IA user_transferred identifies Nicholas Klein; scanningcenter identifies George Blood, L.P.

date.note: The May 2021 upload date is not treated as a documented transfer date.

processing.value: Transferred at 78 rpm using four styli; engineer-preferred version selected
processing.note: The item specifies 3.8, 2.3, 2.8 and 3.3 mil truncated-conical styli. The specific selected stylus and further restoration are not established. Playback audio remains unaltered.

digital.format: Internet Archive VBR MP3 derivative of the supplied 24-bit FLAC disc transfer

composition.value: Historical aria from the 1892 opera Pagliacci
composition.note: The composition is separate from rights in the historic sound recording.

recording.note: Rule 2. IA identifies the historic 1907 Victor/Victrola 88061 issue; DAHR identifies its 17 March 1907 acoustic master. Opened IA metadata contains no licenseurl and no non-commercial licence. This does not rely on a modern uploader’s composition-only tag.
